name: MagicLab
summary:
MagicLab develops general-purpose humanoid robots and embodied-intelligence technology. Founded in January 2024, it combines robot research, product development and application work, with a portfolio spanning humanoid and quadruped forms. Its broader scope includes the engineering and delivery activities required to turn prototypes into usable products.

The company targets a range of industrial, commercial and household scenarios. Its public activity includes large-scale robot performances as well as work on practical applications, using coordinated movement and control as parts of the same development effort. The business emphasizes developing the hardware and intelligent behavior together rather than supplying an isolated robot component.
